products.name: 2.5x4 ft American Flag Pole Sleeve | 210D Nylon | Made in USA
products.description:
Whether upgrading to a spinning pole setup, replacing a worn sleeve-style flag, or equipping a porch bracket that doesn’t support clip attachment on a 5–6 ft house-mounted pole, the 2.5x4 ft pole sleeve is a compact, well-proportioned size for residential displays where a full 3x5 ft flag would overscale. This flag is 100% Made in the USA, verifying domestic materials and compliant American production. The sleeve header slides directly onto the pole rather than attaching with clips or snaps. This sleeved design allows the flag to rotate freely around the pole with changing wind direction, preventing the wrapping and tangling common with grommet flags on spinning residential poles, porch bracket systems, and wall-mounted flag brackets.
Constructed from heavy-duty, aniline-dyed 210D 100% nylon, this outdoor nylon flag is engineered for daily use in sun, rain, and wind. UV-resistant construction and quick-dry performance support consistent color retention year-round — suited for porches, balconies, patio posts, and public celebrations like Memorial Day, Veterans Day, Flag Day, and Independence Day. Built for everyday residential display, this 2.5x4 ft pole sleeve flag makes a dependable gift for veterans, homeowners, and civic organizations that require 100% American made authenticity.

products.name: 6 FT Silver Rotating Flagpole – Anti-Furl Aluminum Pole with Ball Bearings, Brass-Finished Topper, 2-Piece Outdoor Residential Flag Pole for House Mounting
products.description:
Upgrade your home’s flag display with this 6 ft Silver Aluminum Anti-Furl Rotating Flagpole, designed for durability, smooth performance, and year-round outdoor use.
This premium two-piece aluminum pole features a ball-bearing rotation system that prevents your flag from twisting around the pole. Whether you're flying an American flag, military flag, state flag, or decorative banner, this pole keeps it unfurled and fully visible.

Designed to slide into any 1" outside-diameter bracket, this pole is a perfect fit for most house-mounted flagpole holders (bracket not included). Lightweight yet strong, this pole is built to handle wind, rain, and daily outdoor exposure.
Whether you're replacing an old pole or upgrading to an anti-tangle design, this is the dependable, long-lasting solution for your home.
